section-79-1.TO: issue guidance about the practical application of— (a) the subsidy control principles; (b) the energy and environment principles; (c) the subsidy control requirements in Chapters 2 and 3 of Part 2; (d) the exemptions under Part 3 in respect of the subsidy control requirements; (e) Chapter 1 of Part 4 (including the criteria to be used in determining whether a subsidy or subsidy scheme falls within the meaning of a subsidy, or subsidy scheme, of interest or particular interest under section 11 when applying that Chapter); (f) section 76 (duty to provide pre-action information); (g) section 77 (misuse of subsidies); (h) section 81 (modifications to subsidies and schemes)

section-79-2.TO: deal with (or with any matter connected with)— (a) the determination of whether financial assistance constitutes a subsidy for the purposes of this Act; (b) the meaning or effect of the subsidy control principles; (c) the meaning or effect of the energy and environment principles; (d) the operation of the duty under section 12 or 13 as it applies to— (i) public authorities generally, or (ii) public authorities of a particular description
section-79-2.WHEN: exercising functions within the scope of the duty

section-79-4.TO: publish guidance issued under this section
from time to time revise or replace the guidance

section-79-5.TO: consult such persons as the Secretary of State considers appropriate

section-79-6.TO: have regard to guidance issued under this section
section-79-6.SO FAR AS: applicable to the authority and the circumstances of the case
section-79-6.WHEN: giving a subsidy or making a subsidy scheme

section-79-7.TO: be met by consultation carried out before this section comes into force

section-82-1.TO: by regulations make provision about how the gross cash amount, and the gross cash equivalent amount, is to be determined for the purposes of— (a) section 33(8); (b) section 36(5); (c) section 38(5); (d) section 41(2); (e) provision in regulations or schemes made under this Act

section-86-1.TO: by regulations make provision that is consequential on this Act

section-86-2.TO: amend, repeal, revoke or otherwise modify any provision of primary legislation, assimilated direct legislation or subordinate legislation

section-87-3.WHERE: the regulations are subject to 'the affirmative procedure'
section-87-3.UNLESS: a draft of the statutory instrument containing them has been laid before, and approved by a resolution of, each House of Parliament

section-87-5.FOR: Any provision that may be made by regulations under this Act subject to the negative procedure
section-87-5.TO: be made in regulations subject to the affirmative procedure

section-87-6.FOR: Any power to make regulations under Part 4 to amend a provision of this Act
section-87-6.AFTER: the period of one year beginning with the day on which the CMA publishes its second report under section 65

section-88-2.TO: be varied or revoked by a further direction

section-91-4.TO: by regulations make transitional or saving provision in connection with the coming into force of any provision of this Act
